mostWorthwhile.text: Adding oxygen to the red cells was most worthwhile: the result showed that oxygen can attach and later be released near tissues.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the final components was clear but predictable; the outlines and the only offered combination already showed what to do.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the mature red cells had no nuclei.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the white cells and platelets were added together before their individual jobs were explained in the final result.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the pictures made the blood components' different roles understandable, and I'd be curious to see how they work in the body.
